free_tier.stated: 12 months of DigitalOcean credits for accepted startups. Eligibility: must have raised USD 10m or less, must have a company website and an email address on that domain, and must create a registered DigitalOcean team account with a business email. Applicants with no VC, incubator or accelerator apply by selecting Other for the partner field. Participants are generally entitled to a USD 10,000 monthly limit, with charges applying above it.

egress.terms: not published on the startup program page; the credits pay for ordinary DigitalOcean products, whose Droplet terms are: free outbound transfer included per plan from 500 GiB a month, then $0.01 per GiB; inbound is free
egress.free_allowance: 500 GiB a month on the smallest Droplet

interface_detail: REST API (HTTP requests) and the doctl CLI, both documented at docs.digitalocean.com/reference
tooling: doctl, the official DigitalOcean CLI; the REST API reference has request samples in cURL, Python, Go and Ruby
chaining: The core credits exclude every GPU product, so the value is CPU droplets, Spaces and managed databases: at a USD 10,000 monthly limit a small always-on stack runs for a year. GPU access is a separate application and is not covered, which is where the chain breaks for ML work.

limits.value: A program manager decides the award and the amount stays unnamed until the onboarding email, so an applicant cannot plan against a number; the one-year expiry and the USD 10,000 monthly ceiling bind after that.

identity_cost.detail: The published criteria ask for a company website, a domain email and a registered team account, and provide an explicit route for applicants with no partner organization. No incorporation certificate is named on the program page. The credit amount is set by the partner, not by the applicant.

notes: The credit amount is genuinely not published: the page says DigitalOcean awards credits through partners and directs the applicant to a program manager. Recording a dollar ceiling here would be invention, so the ceiling is null and the monthly limit of USD 10,000 is what the page states. One directory reported a USD 100K figure from a 2024 press release, which the current page supersedes.
